Title: Mt Fuji Private 8 Hour Car Tour with Airport Pickup or Drop-off
Description:
Skip the stress of navigating trains after a long flight. Our private airport transfer and Mt. Fuji charter service takes you straight from Narita or Haneda to the heart of Japan’s most iconic destination — Mt. Fuji.

No transfers. No dragging luggage. Just a smooth, private ride in a clean, air-conditioned Alphard or Hiace, with a professional driver.

Whether you're heading to a lakeside ryokan in Kawaguchiko, a hotel in Fujiyoshida, or an outlet mall in Gotemba, we’ll get you there directly, safely, and comfortably. This is ideal for:

▪︎ Families and groups with luggage
▪︎ Couples on a relaxing getaway
▪︎ First-time visitors to Japan
▪︎ Anyone who wants to enjoy the view, not figure out directions

We offer fixed pricing, door-to-door pickup, and timed service — the driver arrives when you request, waits up to 30 minutes for airport pickups, or 15 minutes at hotels.

Planning to head back to the airport from Mt. Fuji? We’ve got you covered with return service too.
